edges.condition: Project behavior or startup is unclear
edges.guidance: Read relevant docs, manifests, entry points and existing tests. Follow file references selectively.
edges.pitfalls: Do not assume all projects use the same framework or read secret files.

edges.condition: Enough evidence to describe the requested feature
edges.guidance: Create cases with observable expected outcomes, setup, happy paths, invalid inputs and boundaries.
edges.pitfalls: Implementation behavior is not proof of intended behavior. State assumptions and questions.

edges.condition: The plan is ready and execution is requested
edges.guidance: Use documented startup commands and disposable test data. Track each process you start.
edges.pitfalls: Do not edit product code to make a test pass. Do not use production data.

edges.guidance: Inspect logs and check readiness before testing. A process existing does not establish readiness.
edges.pitfalls: Avoid fixed sleeps and repeated restarts with unchanged configuration.

edges.guidance: Exercise the requested feature through browser, terminal or HTTP and compare actual outcomes with the plan.
edges.pitfalls: A successful tool call alone does not prove the feature works.

edges.guidance: Cover failure paths and boundary inputs. Reset relevant state between independent cases.
edges.pitfalls: Preserve exploratory freedom; this graph is guidance, not a list of mandatory actions.

edges.condition: Unexpected behavior or a tool failure
edges.guidance: Inspect the evidence, distinguish environment failures from product defects, and reproduce where possible.
edges.pitfalls: Do not retry the same failing action indefinitely or label a missing dependency a product bug.

edges.condition: The cause is understood or setup is corrected
edges.guidance: Continue the relevant case and record what changed.
edges.pitfalls: Do not erase evidence of earlier failures.

edges.condition: Cases are assessed or the budget is exhausted
edges.guidance: Cite captured evidence; report passes, failures, blockers and uncertainty separately.
edges.pitfalls: Never invent observations. Finding a real defect is a successful QA outcome.

edges.guidance: Record the blocker and identify untested cases.
edges.pitfalls: Do not mark unexecuted cases passed.
